title: An Adaptive Method for Optimal Control Problems Constrained by Parabolic Differential Equations
summary: An adaptive direct collocation method is developed for solving optimal control problems constrained by parabolic partial differential equations. The partial differential equation is first reformulated in a variational setting, where the spatial domain is discretized using the hp-Galerkin finite element method. To address nonlinearities in the variational form, a Kirchhoff-like integral transformation is applied to linearize the dynamics.
